source_request: Please make a bra detail photo showing the ring and slider on a shoulder strap, so the strap adjustment is easy to understand.
interpreted_intent: The synthetic requester requires a bra strap detail showing ring and slider so adjustment is understandable. I choose a resting garment and a visible return path between the two hardware pieces; this establishes a mechanism without inventing a hand operating it. Green cloth, counter setting and diagonal arrangement are editable author choices. Hardware legibility and a coherent fabric path are the intended experience under the saved controls.
subject: A bra, with one shoulder strap and its adjustment hardware emphasized.
setting: A warm white dressing-room counter beside a window and off-white wall.
event: The ring and slider are threaded into a shoulder strap and the returning fabric path is visible.
visual_priorities: Ring and slider read as different pieces on one shoulder strap.
The returning fabric path explains the adjustment mechanism.
The band and cup edge keep the isolated detail connected to the bra.
baseline_prompt_en: A detail photograph follows the adjustment hardware on a bra laid across a warm white dressing-room counter. A ring and slider sit on one shoulder strap. The narrow strap passes through the ring and returns to the slider, where its folded path around the center bar is visible. A short length of the band and the edge of a cup remain in view, connecting this detail to the garment. Moss-green fabric gives the bright metal edges a quiet contrast. The strap makes a loose diagonal across the counter; the ring and slider occupy separate, equally sharp positions along it. Daylight from a nearby window grazes the woven fibers. A softly receding off-white wall keeps the background simple, allowing the returning fabric path to explain how the adjustment works.
